_comment: How the core's screens hang together (see docs/modding.md, "flow"): the frame every game has, the main menu, the
garage and its car lot, the racing hub, the career, the race and the tools. Every screen has an id and a kind the
program has; its "exits" are its ways out by name, each to a screen id. The places a game goes to (a diner, the
street, the shops, the dealers, the paper, a gas station, a paint booth) are its setting's: a mod's flow/*.json goes
over this one key by key and adds the screens of the kinds it has, wires their exits (the racing hub's "streets"
too) and puts their tiles round the garage's car. A place no flow has is not in the game, nor is what goes with it.
A way out to a screen that is not there goes "home" instead, or its button is not shown. "system" names the
